# TapestryPreview

What an agent would wake up knowing if these subjects walked in now: the "What You Know" that would be woven into its instructions, made without starting a session or changing any thread.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `loomId` | `uuid` | The loom. |
| `agentName` | `string \| null` | The agent waking up. Its own private notes are included; other agents' are not. Null: shared threads only. |
| `subjects` | `string[]` | The people and things present, as named. |
| `tokenBudget` | `integer` | The most tokens the tapestry may take, after the same limits a run applies. |
| `text` | `string` | The woven text, exactly as it would sit in the system prompt. |
| `threadIds` | `uuid[]` | The threads the tapestry was woven from. |
| `isEmptyLoom` | `boolean` | Nothing has been woven yet: the agent would be born, not wake up. |

## Example

```json
{
  "loomId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "agentName": "...",
  "subjects": [
    "..."
  ],
  "tokenBudget": 0,
  "text": "...",
  "threadIds": [
    "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f"
  ],
  "isEmptyLoom": false
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`looms.tapestry`](../api/looms.md) (`GET /looms/by-id/{id}/tapestry`)
